mapper.select: SELECT it.id, it.name, it.user_id, us.username FROM items it INNER join users us ON it.user_id = us.id WHERE it.id = #{id};
SELECT it.id, it.name, it.user_id, us.username FROM items it INNER join users us ON it.user_id = us.id ORDER BY it.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset};
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id};
